categories.main_business_segments: Nagawa Co., Ltd. operates three main business segments: (1) Unit House Business, which involves the manufacturing, sales, and rental of unit houses and related office equipment; (2) Module/System Construction Business, which covers the construction and sales of modular and system buildings; and (3) Construction Machinery Rental Business, which provides sales and rental of construction machinery.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include the industrialized production of unit houses (notably the 'Super House' brand), with over 90% factory-based manufacturing, precision dimensioning (1mm standard), and advanced quality management systems (ISO9001 certified). Production efficiency is enhanced by automation, such as fully automated welding robots, and the company holds national certifications for steel frame performance (R-grade).
categories.primary_customers_markets: Nagawa primarily serves construction and civil engineering companies, both in the public and private sectors, as well as event organizers and government agencies (for disaster relief and temporary facilities). Its end markets include construction sites, public infrastructure projects, commercial facilities, event venues, and emergency/disaster response needs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are nationwide in Japan, with a network of factories and sales offices from Hokkaido to Kyushu. While it previously had overseas subsidiaries, its current business is almost entirely domestic, with over 90% of sales to Japanese customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nagawa operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, acting as a manufacturer, assembler, and direct provider of modular buildings and rental assets to end users and intermediaries (such as construction machinery rental companies).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding domestic sales networks (especially through new and satellite showrooms), strengthening proposal capabilities via digital tools (3D estimation, VR), and increasing production capacity through automation and facility investment. The company is also focused on sustainability (reusability, waste reduction), human capital development (qualification support), and is considering renewed overseas expansion. R&D is oriented toward new products, construction methods, and digitalization of sales and design processes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through a mix of product sales (unit houses, modular buildings), rental income (unit houses and construction machinery), and related services. Rental income is a significant and growing component, with assets held for multi-year rental cycles, while sales include both new and used units.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nagawa is positioned as a leading manufacturer in the Japanese unit house and modular construction market, with a strong brand and high market share in 'Super House' units. Key competitors include other modular building manufacturers and construction machinery rental firms, but Nagawa differentiates itself through quality, scale, and integrated manufacturing-to-rental operations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, Nagawa reported sales of 35.3 billion yen (approx. $230 million), operating profit of 4.3 billion yen, and net profit of 4.2 billion yen, with an 8.3% year-on-year sales growth and a 34.7% increase in net profit. The company maintains a high equity ratio (88.4%) and robust cash position, with steady growth in both rental assets and sales.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nagawa emphasizes high-quality, precision-manufactured modular buildings with rapid delivery, cost efficiency, and strong after-sales support. Its products are highly reusable and environmentally friendly, supporting disaster response and public needs. The company’s integrated model—covering manufacturing, sales, and rental—enables flexible solutions and superior customer responsiveness, setting it apart from competitors.
